notes:
Summary: Helmsman Rail Operations (national commuter rail operator) evaluating Redwood Private for an on-prem, air-gapped inference stack to support real-time dispatch assistant + incident summarization. Very conservative security posture: no egress allowed from primary datacenter; keys must be customer-owned (HSM integration); evidence of ISO27001 and SOC2 controls required for procurement.

Key contacts:
- James Armitage, Head of Digital Operations (primary technical sponsor) — prefers technical details, asked about KV-cache persistence in air-gapped mode.
- Laila Mendes, Procurement (procurement lead for IT projects) — procurement timeline ~8–10 weeks after PoC.

Recent activity / timeline:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (Maya + Daniel) — overview of Redwood Private, confirmed ability to run in isolated DC. Action: send high-level architecture. (fireflies ff_20260225_helmsman_intro)
- 2026-02-05: Security questionnaire received from Helmsman; SE responded with baseline controls and diagram.
- 2026-02-18: On-site meeting at regional operations center; verified physical network constraints and discussed air-gap bootstrapping options. Notes: limited outbound ports, removable media policy.
- 2026-02-25: Security deep-dive (ff_20260301_security_deepdive) — asked for KMS/HSM integration options, FIPS compatibility, and deployment checklist for air-gapped installs.
- 2026-03-01: Agreement to run 8-week PoC: 2 nodes on-prem (quantized LLM for dispatch), offline embedding index for timetable search, integration with internal SSO via SAML. PoC scope doc in Drive.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Must deploy in Helmsman's on-prem datacenter (air-gapped): no external network calls during inference.
- Model preferences: open, quantized Llama-family or Mistral small-medium; will accept Redwood-provided model artifacts if packaged and delivered offline.
- Latency SLOs: 95th pct < 350ms for dispatch messages under expected load (10 req/s sustained during peak).
- Throughput: burst to 30 req/s for short intervals; need autoscaling policy for Dedicated equivalent on-prem.
- Data handling: all logs/audit trails stored locally for 7 years; retention controls required.
- Identity: SSO via SAML, customer-managed certificates, HSM for key wrapping.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Budget band discussed verbally: £90k–£200k ARR depending on PoC results and support tier.
- Preference for multi-year support contract tied to on-site SLA.
- Procurement wants vendor security pack and sub-contractor list before legal.

Sales play / recommended next steps:
- Schedule infra workshop (onsite) week of 2026-03-15 to map network and HSM connectivity. Owner: Maya + Daniel.
- Deliver air-gapped deployment runbook and HSM integration design by 2026-03-12.
- Prepare PoC image bundle and offline model delivery checklist; include quantization recommendations from Optimize team.
- Provide ISO27001 evidence packet and SOC2 summary to Laila by 2026-03-08 (drive links).

Quotes / verbatim bits:
- "We cannot have any outbound egress during normal operations; staging is allowed but must be auditable." — James A.
- "If you can show HSM integration and a reproducible air-gap install, we can accelerate to procurement." — L. Mendes

POC milestones (proposed):
- Week 1: Delivery of install bundle + on-site infra validation.
- Weeks 2–3: Model load, SSO hookup, basic dispatch test harness.
- Weeks 4–6: Latency tuning, batching/kv cache config, safety filters.
- Week 7: Security review and evidence hand-off.
- Week 8: Executive demo + decision.

Open questions for Redwood:
- Detailed HSM/KMS integration playbook for air-gapped mode (needed).
- Signed assurance on model artifacts (provenance) for procurement.
- FIPS/crypto compliance details for EU operations.

Next meeting: infra workshop + HSM mapping (onsite) — target 2026-03-16.
